_notes: What UQM 0.8.0's own encounter screen and battle-won screen draw, recorded by running its InitEncounter and UninitEncounter (encount.c, with sis.c, menu.c, border.c, util.c and pickship.c's drawing) with each drawing call recorded as screens.json's are (tools/extract/golden/encounter.c); the frames counted from the official content package (SHA-256 77d75ac25e6fb755a33c4ba3b38a7b7bc41fcbc02896891b0cc9ac9214b72eef), the fonts by their leading.

Each scenario: where (hyper: IN_HYPERSPACE, "ENCOUNTER IN DEEP SPACE"; system: IN_INTERPLANETARY, "ENCOUNTER AT" the cluster, {cluster}, and GLOBAL_SIS (PlanetName), {planet}), the gravity well's resource (planet[0], drawn in the screen's middle), the flagship's name, the group's ships (npc_built_ship_q: [race, crew], crew -1 an infinite fleet; each race's strings read {gs:1000 + its number in races.h's order}), and the step: "encounter" draws InitEncounter's screen up to its menu; "won:KEYS" UninitEncounter after a battle won, every wait and fade in the one step: KEYS none (no key), any (a key held: AnyButtonPress TRUE, so each fade is cut to its last colour and WaitForAnyButton, waiting for a new press, runs out), escape (Escape held too: the debris's part skipped).
drawn: the calls as screens.json's; frames and rects as there.
